# Synthetic water parser fixtures

Every file in this directory was written for tests. They are invented examples in publisher-compatible shapes, not captured responses, source records, or assertions about river conditions. The PDF is a minimal synthetic document used to test document-byte verification. Names and values in these fixtures must never be seeded into resident-facing data.

The production correction URL and expected SHA-256 in the Cambridge adapter refer to a publisher document; tests substitute this fixture's digest to exercise the verification path without redistributing that document.
